app.tagline: Understand your work rights in the UAE, in your own language.
error.network: We could not reach Haqqi. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.busy: The assistant is busy or offline. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.invalid: The assistant gave an answer we could not check. Please try again.
error.notFound: This case was not found. Cases are deleted after 7 days.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
picker.title: Choose your language
story.title: What happened at work?
story.help: Tell us in your own words: your job, your salary, when you started, and what went wrong.
story.placeholder: For example: I work in construction in Sharjah. My salary is 1,800 dirhams. I have not been paid for 3 months…
story.privacy: Do not write your name, phone number, passport, Emirates ID or labour card number.
story.processing: Your story is processed by Google Gemini to understand your case.
story.tooLong: Your story is too long. Please keep it under {max} characters.
confirm.title: Check your details
confirm.help: We filled in what we understood from your story. Check each answer and correct anything that is wrong.
confirm.needInfo: We need a few more details before we can check your case.
confirm.basicAboveTotal: The basic salary cannot be more than the total salary.
confirm.endBeforeStart: The last day cannot be before the start date.
field.basicWageHelp: Basic salary only, without allowances. It is written in your contract.
field.totalWageHelp: Basic salary plus all allowances (housing, transport, food).
field.deductedAmount: Total amount cut from your salary (AED)
field.unpaidAbsenceDays: Days of unpaid leave or absence
progress.title: Checking your case
progress.help: This usually takes under a minute. Please keep this page open.
results.title: Your result
results.violations: What your employer may have done wrong
results.noViolations: We did not find a clear violation in what you told us.
results.inEnglish: Legal details are shown in English.
results.aboveLimit: Your claim is above AED 50,000. MOHRE may send it to the labour court.
results.workerOwesHelp: You resigned without working your full notice, so your employer may claim this. It is not taken off your total.
results.complaintSoon: The formal Arabic complaint for MOHRE will be available here soon.
results.gemini: Your story was processed by Google Gemini to prepare this result.
results.writerFailed: We couldn't prepare the plain-language explanation and the Arabic letter this time. The findings and amounts below are checked and correct.
referral.title: Haqqi cannot check this case
referral.domestic: Domestic workers are covered by a separate law that Haqqi does not check. Contact MOHRE about your case.
referral.difc_adgm: DIFC and ADGM have their own employment laws and courts, so the federal labour law does not apply. Use the DIFC or ADGM courts' employment services.
referral.free_zone: Federal gratuity rules mostly apply in free zones, but complaints go to your free zone authority first, not MOHRE. Contact your free zone authority.
referral.mohre: MOHRE: call 80084 or use the MOHRE app.
disclaimer.title: Important
disclaimer.text: Haqqi gives guidance and a draft, not legal advice. For official help, contact MOHRE on 80084 or use the MOHRE app or website.
